nina: Quick sync — ran a randomized-control prefetch + speculative decode run on nova-quant-70b yesterday. Short summary: ~1.8x tokens/sec uplift, but cohort A shows a 0.9% quality regression on our LLM-evals (safety + factuality heldouts).

raj: nice! what's the setup? batch sizes, kv cache warm vs cold?

nina: setup:
- model: nova-quant-70b (int8/qs8)
- mode: speculative decoding (topk=50, speculative ratio 0.25)
- prefetch: prefix kv caching enabled for sessions > 128 tokens
- batching: dynamic, target batch 8
- eval sets: lfqa-synthetic (500), helpful-chat (2k), factual-checks (500)

oliver: can you paste the run command/flags?

nina: sure:
```
run_expt --model nova-quant-70b --speculative true --spec-topk 50 \
  --spec-ratio 0.25 --prefetch-prefix 128 --batch-target 8 \
  --seed 42 --eval-sets lfqa,helpful-chat,factual
```

tess: what metrics drove the "0.9% regression" call? AUC/Winrate? any ops-level failures?

nina: primary is win-rate (pairwise against baseline decode) on helpful-chat = -0.9% absolute. factual-checks exact match also down 0.6%. latency p95 improved from 420ms -> 270ms. error rate (nan/oom) unchanged. No safety flags spike.

raj: interesting tradeoff. Did you stratify by prompt length? prefetched vs cold sessions?

nina: yes — short prompts (<64 tokens) saw ~2.4x throughput and neutral quality. Long contexts (>512) had the reg. Hypothesis: speculative sampler picks higher-entropy candidates early, causing drift with long-context conditioning.

oliver: can we try lowering spec-ratio to 0.15 and increase spec-topk to 80? maybe reduce regressions but keep perf.

nina: queued. Also adding a control with kv-prefetch disabled for long sessions (explicit gating) to compare.

canary-bot: canary build deployed to canary fleet id c-97 for A/B. Monitoring: latency, win-rate, safety-delta.

tess: good. next steps: (1) run spec-ratio sweep [0.1,0.15,0.2], (2) split eval into short/long contexts, (3) add human eval on 200 edge cases if delta persists. I'll sync infra for longer runs.

nina: thanks — will push the sweep and update thread with artifacts + perf traces. :eyes:

raj: please add the exact random seed & commit hash in run metadata so we can repro.

nina: added GH commit: ab12f3d. seed 42. attaching small artifact link: https://redwood.artifacts/s/2987654321/spec-sweep

oliver: ping me if you want me to run the human eval batch.

nina: will do. end.
